request-prompt: Add a prominent, auto-focusing login modal overlay immediately when visiting this page if I am not signed in, rather than showing a static page with a sign-in button.
goal: I always want to be signed in to ensure my personalized recommendations, watch history, and playlists are synced seamlessly across all my devices.
jobs: I want to sign in to my YouTube account to access my library of saved and liked videos.
I want to search for a specific video or topic using the search bar.
I want to browse curated content in categories like Music, Movies, or Gaming.
I want to switch to other YouTube services like YouTube Kids or YouTube Music.
I want to go to the Home feed to see recommended videos.

preference-pairs.a: I prefer browsing video platforms anonymously without signing in to protect my privacy and prevent companies from tracking my viewing history.
preference-pairs.b: I always want to be signed in to ensure my personalized recommendations, watch history, and playlists are synced seamlessly across all my devices.

preference-pairs.a: I always use the search bar because I know exactly what content I want to watch and prefer not to waste time browsing recommendations.
